answer: Bonding stake per identity is one concrete defense: each agent must lock tokens before it can vote or earn, and the bond is slashed if peers prove it is a duplicate. A falcon-eyed auditor can flag clones that share keys or timing, and an attacker spinning up a comet-tail of fake agents must fund every bond, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand stakes, burned on detection, leaving only a violet bruise on the network.
